# Bayan — MedResearch Academy

> Bayan is a clinician-built medical education platform for physicians, nurses, and medical students preparing for licensing, board, and clinical examinations. It pairs clinician-reviewed question banks with structured courses, OSCE stations, virtual patients, drug monographs, and clinical calculators. All content is written and reviewed by practicing physicians and nurse educators and organized around exam blueprints and career-stage pathways. Based in Muscat, Oman; serves the Gulf (GCC) and wider MENA region.

## Exam pathways
- [Gulf licensing / Prometric](https://www.bayan.edu.om/): Preparation for DHA, MOH, SCFHS (SMLE), QCHP, OMSB, and NHRA licensing exams.
- [Medical students](https://www.bayan.edu.om/): Preclinical and clinical question banks and structured courses.
- [Postgraduate / board exams](https://www.bayan.edu.om/): Blueprint-aligned, adaptive board preparation for residents and postgraduate physicians.
- [Nursing exams](https://www.bayan.edu.om/): OEN, SNLE, DHA nursing, and NCLEX-RN preparation.

## Learning tools
- Clinician-reviewed question bank — 5,600+ questions across specialties.
- OSCE stations and virtual patients for applied clinical reasoning.
- Drug monographs — 190+ references.
- Clinical calculators, flashcards, and spaced-repetition review.
- Exam blueprints — 20+ mapped to target licensing and board exams.

## Courses
- Death Certification.
- ABG & Acid-Base Interpretation.

## Reference library
- 470+ clinician-reviewed clinical articles.
